title: Rent completion triggers maintenance status for standard equipment
gherkin:
Feature: Post-rent maintenance handling
  Scenario: Standard equipment transitions to maintenance upon rental end
    Given a rental agreement for a standard equipment item
    When the rental end date is reached
    Then the system shall update the rent status to 'Maintenance'
    And the equipment shall be marked as unavailable
rationale: Validates the baseline behavior that upon reaching the rental end date, the system updates rent status to 'Maintenance' and marks items as unavailable during the maintenance period.
usedContextItems: Upon reaching the rental end date, the system shall update the rent status to 'Maintenance'|The system shall mark items as unavailable during maintenance periods

From: ops_lead@toolchain.com
To: dev_leads@toolchain.com, pm_team@toolchain.com
Date: 2026-02-20 14:00
Subject: URGENT: Special Maintenance Rule for Concrete Mixers

Hi Team,

Regardless of what the current SRS (v1.2) says about the dynamic Maintenance Matrix, we have an emergency with Concrete Mixers. 120 minutes is absolutely not enough for proper cleaning/maintenance.

Effective immediately:
- Concrete Mixers MUST have a 12-hour (720 min) maintenance window.
- All other machinery can stay at the 2-hour (120 min) rule for now.

Please hardcode this for the Mixer category until the official Matrix is published in the next SRS version.

Best regards,
Tom (Operations Lead)
